propositions: The generic reads-under-contention property accepts partial-success payloads (shape-valid but content-hollow) on all four surfaces (show/list/search/ready) due to assertion checking only shape, not content presence.
Seeded faults F3 and F6 pass the current shape-only property but fail the original regression test, indicating a detection gap.
The property's intent requires returned records to carry identity (truthy ticket_id), which the current assertion does not enforce.

Content-completeness predicates must be added per-surface: show requires truthy ticket_id on the object; list/search/ready require every element to carry truthy ticket_id, with valid-empty arrays passing vacuously.
The fix is assertion-only with no new subprocess calls, rounds, or fixtures, preserving wall-clock runtime.
